L1 — Theorem 11 uses an expectation bound as a pointwise bracketing bound — Counterevidence: This does not refute the assertion of Theorem 11 or the properly qualified consistency result. Their corrected proofs are supplied above. No inference of a new mathematical flaw from missing code is involved.

L2 — Theorem 14's deterministic Rademacher bound uses an empirical L1 radius where an L2 radius is required — Counterevidence: The finite example directly refutes the displayed deterministic bound, not the complete high-probability inequality including its additive concentration term. The theorem statement describes c_P,m only generically before the proof defines it. No claim is made that every safe-constant formulation of Theorem 14 is false.

L3 — Corollary 5 is derived from a false logarithmic entropy estimate for unrestricted convex bodies — Counterevidence: This does not invalidate the earlier existence or consistency conclusions, which use only finite covers rather than this quantitative entropy order. It also does not refute the independent finite-dimensional parameter counts for ellipsoids, bounded-vertex polytopes or linear images of Schatten balls.

proposition.claim:
Theorem11 original constant brackets fail pointwise.

Theorem14 deterministic finite-class estimate uses inadequate empirical L1 radius.

Corollary5 proof uses false logarithmic convex-body entropy.

Proposition7 lacks likelihood bound/normalization.

Explicit Gaussian optimum has wrong volume normalization.

Theorem7 existence omits nonempty-class condition.

Continuous density with finite second moment need not give positive radial moment.

Absolute continuity alone cannot identify KL and cross-entropy minimizers when all KL values are infinite.
